headline: Multiple injuries as two trains collide north of London
summary: A major incident south of Bedford has left several people injured and disrupted rail services across the region.
details: British Transport Police are responding to a collision involving two trains approximately 60 miles north of London. Media reports indicate that the incident has resulted in multiple injuries.
caption:
Two trains collided north of London, leaving multiple people injured and rail services paralyzed.

headline_marked: 4 [[Detective Branch officers arrested]] for attempting to abduct youth in Narayanganj
headline: 4 Detective Branch officers arrested for attempting to abduct youth in Narayanganj
summary: The officers, who were in plain clothes, were beaten by an angry mob after they allegedly tried to force a 30-year-old man into a car.
details: Four members of the Dhaka district Detective Branch (DB) have been arrested following an incident in Narayanganj’s Rupganj Upazila where they allegedly tried to abduct a local youth.
The victim, 30-year-old Amit Hasan Miraj, claimed that the officers, identifying themselves as CID personnel, detained him in a public toilet under the pretext of investigating an online casino.
When the officers found nothing on his mobile phone, they allegedly tried to force him into a car, prompting Miraj to scream for help.
Locals intervened and severely beat three of the officers—Sub-Inspectors Mamun Matubbar and Aman Ullah, and Constable Kabir—before they were rescued and sent to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.
The fourth officer, Constable Akash Ahmed, was arrested in Dhaka on Friday morning.
A case has been filed against six people, including the four DB members and two associates who are currently on the run.
Rupganj Police have confirmed that the DB members were in plain clothes and that departmental action against the arrestees is now underway.
caption:
Four DB officers were beaten by a mob and arrested after they allegedly tried to abduct a man in Narayanganj.

Four members of the Dhaka district Detective Branch (DB) have been arrested following an incident in Narayanganj’s Rupganj Upazila where they allegedly tried to abduct a local youth.

The victim, 30-year-old Amit Hasan Miraj, claimed that the officers, identifying themselves as CID personnel, detained him in a public toilet under the pretext of investigating an online casino.

When the officers found nothing on his mobile phone, they allegedly tried to force him into a car, prompting Miraj to scream for help.

Locals intervened and severely beat three of the officers—Sub-Inspectors Mamun Matubbar and Aman Ullah, and Constable Kabir—before they were rescued and sent to Dhaka Medical College Hospital.

The fourth officer, Constable Akash Ahmed, was arrested in Dhaka on Friday morning.

A case has been filed against six people, including the four DB members and two associates who are currently on the run.

Rupganj Police have confirmed that the DB members were in plain clothes and that departmental action against the arrestees is now underway.
